verdict.rationale: There is no documented sandbox or test mode. The closest evidence is a self-serve Playground where you paste arbitrary text as state and try questions before writing API calls [jev-docs-21, jev-supp-playground]. Version pinning versus the `jev-preview` alias lets you trial a new model without moving production integrations [jev-supp-versioning]. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox environment or test API keys, documented isolation of test versus production traffic or billing, and any independent hands-on corroboration of using these for safe testing.
